bio: Hey there! My name is Melissa Belladonna, your local Tiefling Alchemist Vtuber. I stream D&D content every Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday at 2pm EST / 9pm EET with gaming and ASMR on the side. If you like what you see, then grab that d20 and roll for initiative!
